publisher: City of Chicago Department of Business Affairs and Consumer Protection
ownership: Official current-active business-license records published through the City of Chicago Data Portal
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS Socrata API. The official view is public, provenance-marked official, API-enabled, and maintained by the City of Chicago.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata, count, and selected-field API queries
source-defined licensed-site and provisional organization normalization
derived business-registry assertions and source-linked relationships
redistribution of aggregate statistics with source attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing a future-expiring issued City license as independent proof that a site is continuously operating, open to the public, solvent, or compliant with every requirement
representing this licensing source as every business in Chicago, Illinois, or the United States because some activities are license-exempt or licensed elsewhere
counting multiple license rows for one account/site as multiple physical sites or businesses
representing a source address or portal coordinate as independently verified or currently occupied
publishing record-level natural-person names or possible residential addresses without an approved privacy review
reconstructing addresses explicitly redacted by the publisher
inferring ownership, parent-company, or cross-source identity without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: City of Chicago Department of Business Affairs and Consumer Protection, Business Licenses - Current Active, via data.cityofchicago.org.
retention: Indefinite for immutable selected-field source and governed normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Aggregate counts may be redistributed with City attribution, exact source refresh, source checksum, and license-scope limitations. Record-level normalized data remains local-review-only pending privacy and terms review.
personal_data_handling: Legal names can identify sole proprietors and licensed addresses can be residences. The connector excludes ownership and contact datasets, honors publisher address redaction, and keeps selected source and normalized record-level artifacts local.
